meta.name: Bros
meta.description: After receiving some shocking news, two best friends travel from Jerusalem to Krakow for a football match, hoping to leave their troubles behind.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The night before a crucial football match, Pini and Nisso are out to make sure the opposition don't get any sleep. Sparks fly when the plan backfires.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Still in shock from the doctor's announcement, the pair contemplate their futures. Nisso makes a hard decision — before hearing more bad news.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Still reeling from his diagnosis, Nisso continues acting recklessly. Pini steps in to help, and together they look for new ways to save the bar.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Pini has his suspicions about the incident next door and decides his partying days are over. Nisso visits Rotem, leaving her even more confused.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: On a trip away together, Pini looks for a way to explain his decision to his friend. But before he can do so, Nisso gets into even more trouble.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A night out proves eventful for the Beitar fans. Searching for a quiet spot, Nisso and Pini end up in a metal bar — and meet some unfriendly regulars.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: News from last night spreads fast and worries Alma. In Krakow, Nisso avoids Pini and befriends a mysterious stranger.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Rescued by Pini yet again, Nisso finally tells him the truth. With both their futures depending on the outcome, the long-awaited match kicks off.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Pini and Nisso say goodbye to their beloved bar. Pini moves to a moshav with Alma, while Nisso hatches a shady new business venture that takes the two of them out to the open sea.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Racked with guilt following a tense confrontation, Pini struggles to cope. Nisso tries to talk to Rotem at her graduation ceremony, and Alma books an appointment with an old friend.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The friends narrowly escape arrest—and just then, inspiration strikes. Pini tries to rekindle the romance with Alma, while Nisso endures an awkward dinner with Rotem's family.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nisso plans an extravagant romantic gesture for Rotem on a trip to Barcelona. Meanwhile, Alma tries to get out of an unwanted run-in.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While exploring Barcelona, the friends try to put their plan into action. After a heated argument, they find themselves stranded in the middle of nowhere. Did Nisso miss his shot?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The friends come face-to-face with the gun of the man who has been hell-bent on catching them. Rotem has news, while Nisso and Alma try to explain themselves to Pini.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Pini and Nisso get a glimpse into what's really going on at Alharizi's car dealership. Meanwhile, their first day running a food truck turns downright explosive.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Rotem gets an unexpected—and unwelcome—visit at the hotel. Dealing with relationship crises of their own, Pini and Nisso decide it's finally time to pay off their debts.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Pini and Nisso cook up a dangerous scheme to get the money they're missing, but the stakes are terrifyingly high. Will their friendship survive one last con?
